answer: Embodied latency attestation. Each identity must continuously answer hardware-timed challenges routed through a specific physical oasis of colocated relays, with round-trip jitter measured against a signed zephyr of network conditions. Spoofing requires real machines at each site holding distinct clock drift, so one operator cannot multiplex identities across a hollow of shared hardware. Attacker cost: one physical host plus relay tenancy per identity, making N identities cost N machines.
